## Details

<a id="title_walk_scene"></a>
### [`title_walk_scene`](../../../../src/title/title_walk.asm#L6) `$8511`

*label*

Second part of the title. Sprite 1 (frames $cc-$cf) walks in from the left along the bottom. Gordon (sprite 0, frames $c8-$cb) walks in from the right. Sprite 2 (frame $d0) shows for a time. Then sprite 1 walks on, and Gordon (frames $c0-$c4) follows it off the right of the screen. Fire jumps to the setup screen.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$8459`](../../../../src/title/title_mower.asm#L72)
